MaxBundle_Mickey/Mickey_Barks_MaxBark001.en: Hiya, Max! Gosh, you sure are a great dog!

MaxBundle_Mickey/Mickey_Barks_MaxBark002.en: Aw, you remind me of my pup Pluto. A much fluffier Pluto, ha-ha!

MaxBundle_Mickey/Mickey_Discussions_Disc.en: Welp, have fun! I'm sure Max will love the walk.
